summary: AIR Global PLC filed a 6-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary AIR Limited closed a previously announced offering of $425,000,000 7.875% senior unsecured notes due 2031 via Rule 144A and Regulation S. The notes are guaranteed by AIR Global PLC and several operating subsidiaries, with Citibank, N.A., London Branch as trustee and paying agent. This is a routine debt-financing disclosure, not a special situation; no equity stake, per-share price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or change-of-control event is stated. Watch covenant capacity and refinancing overhang.
